name: Eldrazi Temple
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only to cast colorless Eldrazi spells or activate abilities of colorless Eldrazi.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add {C}{C}. Spend this mana only to cast colorless Eldrazi spells or activate abilities of colorless Eldrazi.

needs.what: a colour predicate inside a mana_restriction group, e.g. {"colorless": true}, so a group can be the all-of ["eldrazi", {"colorless": true}] on both the cast half (the spell's colours) and the activate half (the source's current colours)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_restriction groups match only lowercased types/subtypes/supertypes (costs.spell_purpose / ability_purpose build SpendPurpose.names from types, subtypes and supertypes) plus the mana_value and x_in_mana_cost predicates (RESTRICTION_PREDICATES). Colour is not in SpendPurpose, so a literal "colorless" name matches nothing and makes the mana unspendable, while {"cast": [["eldrazi"]], "activate": [["eldrazi"]]} drops the colorless clause and funds coloured Eldrazi too -- a strictly better card than printed
